rationales: E-mail is short for electronic mail.
Electrical mail is not what e-mail stands for.
Electronic medium is not the expansion of e-mail.
Electronic message is not the standard expansion of e-mail.
A communication system has more than one basic component.
Three is fewer than the five basic components.
The five components are sender, receiver, message, medium, and protocol.
Six is not the standard number of basic components.
IPv4 addresses contain more than 31 bits.
IPv4 addresses contain more than 29 bits.
An IPv4 address is made up of 32 binary bits.
IPv4 addresses contain more than 30 bits.
Hacking means unauthorized access to computer systems, not making illegal software copies.
Making illegal copies of software is called piracy.
Counterfeiting is imitation of goods or documents, not the standard term for illegal software copying.
Sabotage means deliberate damage or disruption, not illegal copying.
A key alone is not the usual authentication credential described here.
Piracy is illegal copying, not an authentication method.
A patent protects an invention and is not used to authenticate a user.
A password is used to authenticate a user entering a system.
The body element contains the page's visible content.
The head element contains metadata about the HTML document.
The title element gives the document its title but is not the metadata container.
The html element encloses the whole HTML document.
The br tag inserts a line break.
The hr tag creates a thematic break, typically shown as a horizontal line.
The u tag underlines text.
The b tag makes text bold.
Act it out means to demonstrate or perform something, not describe an unplanned solution.
A candid solution is spontaneous and unplanned.
A prototype is an early model or version of a product.
To guess means to estimate without sufficient information, not the term for a spontaneous solution.
10000₂ equals 16, not 17.
10110₂ equals 22, not 17.
10001₂ equals 17.
101000₂ equals 40, not 17.
A simple proposition expresses one statement rather than combining propositions.
A mixed proposition is not the standard term for a proposition formed by combining propositions.
A compound proposition combines two or more propositions.
Full proposition is not the standard term for a proposition formed by combining propositions.
The bold tag is written <b>, not <bold>.
<bd> is not the HTML tag for bold text.
The br tag inserts a line break.
The b tag makes the enclosed text bold.
The p tag defines a paragraph.
The b tag makes text bold.
The u tag underlines the enclosed text.
The i tag italicizes text.
A prepared solution is planned rather than spontaneous and unplanned.
A candid solution is not reached through proper algorithms or work planning.
A strategized solution is developed through planning.
A best solution is selected through evaluation rather than being inherently unplanned.
A flowchart graphically represents steps but is not the set of steps itself.
An algorithm is a set of steps for solving a problem.
A guess is an estimate, not a systematic set of steps.
A prototype is an early model or version of a product.
A kilobyte is conventionally 1024 bytes in this context, not 1000.
Eight is the number of bits in a byte, not the number of bytes in a kilobyte.
One kilobyte is 1024 bytes in the convention used by this question.
Four is not the number of bytes in a kilobyte.
